feedback.end: Water is a liquid. You can pour water because it is runny.
feedback.wrong: A chair is a solid and keeps its shape when moved.

instruction.text: Which thing changes shape based on the container that it is in?

feedback.end: Juice is a liquid. The juice has taken the shape of the jug and glass that it is in.
feedback.wrong: A rock is a solid. If you put a rock in a container, it will not change shape.

instruction.text: Find the surface level of the water in the jug.

trainers.instruction: The jug is then tipped. Has the water remained level?

feedback.end: A liquid remains level when it is in a container.

instruction.text: The volume is the amount of liquid that is in the container. What is the volume of juice in this container?

trainers.instruction: The juice is then poured into a narrower container. Answer the following questions.

atoms.a: Has the shape of the liquid changed?
Has the volume of the liquid changed?

feedback.finish: The volume of a liquid does not change when it is poured from one container to another.

instruction.text: What are the properties of a liquid?

sound: Liquids are runny and can be poured.
Liquids change shape to fit a container.
Liquids have a level surface in a container
